chunks: Their Lord responded to them, saying: 'I will not allow the work of any worker among you to be lost, whether male or female; you are all from one another. And those who migrated and were expelled from their homes and were harmed in My cause, and who fought and were killed, I will surely remove their sins for them, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, as a reward from Allah. And with Allah is the best of rewards.'

key_terms.بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ: you are from one another (unity of gender)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who migrate and are killed in the cause of God according to Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited as the 'Verse of the Doers' (Ayat al-Amilin), affirms the universal validity of divine reward for both men and women, countering early patriarchal interpretations that might have marginalized female contributions. It specifically details the recompense for the Muhajirun and those who strive and are martyred in God's cause, promising the expiation of sins and entry into Gardens beneath which rivers flow, a reward originating directly from Allah.
